text:
A teacher asks, ‘Why do we put a fuse in a mains circuit?’
Student 1 says, ‘It protects the wiring from overheating.’ Student 2 says, ‘It protects us from
getting a shock if we touch the live wire.’
Who is correct?
A
both students
B
neither student
C
student 1 only
D
student 2 only
subject: Physics
